title: Rotten Flesh Farmland
description: Adds Block of Rotten Flesh to grow crops faster.
body:
**Adds Block of Rotten Flesh:**
- Crafted from 4 Rotten Flesh
- Crops can be planted on it without tilling
- Crops on Blocks of Rotten Flesh grow slightly faster than crops on moist/lit Farmland
- Crops can't be trampled on it
- Offers a way to compress Rotten Flesh (can be uncrafted)
